Alas—from the Three Dynasties and earlier, every state had governed by granting fiefs and ruling through enfeoffed lords.
自三代以上 points back through the Three Dynasties into earlier antiquity; 'onward' reverses the temporal direction.

Ji Prefecture: established in the second year of Guangshun under Later Zhou by carving out Juye and Yuncheng from Yanzhou, Rencheng from Yanzhou, and Jinxiang from Danzhou as subordinate counties, with the seat at Juye.

Ji Prefecture: established in the second year of Guangshun under Later Zhou by carving out Juye and Yuncheng from Yun Prefecture, Rencheng from Yan Prefecture, and Jinxiang from Dan Prefecture as subordinate counties, with the seat at Juye.
The source distinguishes Yun Prefecture 鄆州 from Yan Prefecture 兗州; the existing English collapses both into Yanzhou.
